value.name: Dicky confronts Charlene about Micky
value.description: Dicky angrily argues with Charlene, claiming he knows what happened in the ring and insulting her life.
evidence: DICKY (PAUSES) I was in the fuckin' ring with 'im, Chalene, don't you think I know what happened? But I went ten rounds with Sugar Ray Leonard, what the fuck have you evah done? Is your life so great?

value.name: Charlene defends Micky's chance
value.description: Charlene admits her life without Micky is empty but insists she loves him and wants him to have his chance.
evidence: CHARLENE Maybe, the part without Micky sucks. Maybe I never did anything special like you, but I love Micky and I want him to have his chance.

value.name: Dicky and Charlene agree to stop fighting
value.description: Dicky tells Charlene to leave him alone and both agree to keep their bullshit away from Micky.
evidence: DICKY Then leave me alone. He needs me, you heard him, and I know he needs you, so let's spare him the bullshit from either one of us.
She looks at him. Nods grudgingly.
CHARLENE OK. I'll see ya in Micky's corner, otherwise go fuck yourself.
Dicky nods, walks off the porch.

value.name: Micky arrives and sees Dicky leaving
value.description: Micky pulls up at Charlene's apartment building and is surprised to find Dicky leaving after their reconciliation.
evidence: STREET - CHARLENE'S APARTMENT BUILDING - LATE AFTERNOON .Micky slams the door of his car, walks to see: Dicky leaving.
MICKY (SURPRISED) - What the hell are you doin' here?

value.name: Dicky says they worked it out for Micky
value.description: Dicky tells Micky that he and Charlene have settled things for his sake and that everything is together now.
evidence: DICKY We worked it out fah you. Ask her. It's all together.
Micky looks up and sees Charlene standing in the door. She nods.

value.name: Micky accepts the reconciliation
value.description: Micky approves the truce and tells Dicky to bring O'Keefe back as well before heading toward Charlene.
evidence: MICKY Good. Get O'Keefe back, too.
DICKY Micky nods, heads toward Charlene.
